title: Which ending to enter

D0.outcome: Explains choosing which ending to enter: trade into a known win, avoid structures that lose the ending.

D1.outcome: Given a material edge and a trade sequence, names the resulting ending and whether it wins.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides whether to simplify, keeping or avoiding the queen exchange, after checking the ending.

D3.outcome: Verifies the chosen ending by the tablebase or by technique, and predicts how an extra pawn on the other wing changes the choice.

conditions: The ending is known or calculable and the opponent has no counterplay.
contrasts: An extra pawn in a rook ending, which is seldom enough.
Trading into a pawn ending that looks easy but loses the opposition.
A position where the trade is forced anyway.
